svg.title: Every individual expanded public slowdown over 20%
svg.desc: Public development only; final independent benchmark failed; no final winner. CPython, C, Rust, and Zig ran the same 4096 calibration-only public cases, 13 paired trials, and 2000 bootstrap draws. Every one of the 2,313 observed substantial slowdowns; no case is hidden. Public manifest SHA-256 5f49f255271b8f71786e7fa67a61827b53c1330e1ad7afe29c8750991df4b90f; public summary SHA-256 a5c5b3ad70c8fcb1df81da63ab30e727793e8a98c04c0889ca27ae9dce808bfc. Final speed, final memory, and final candidate ranking: NOT MEASURED. Final winner: NONE.

C: 461/4,096 cases more than 20% slower than CPython
Zig: 786/4,096 cases more than 20% slower than CPython
Rust: 1,066/4,096 cases more than 20% slower than CPython
Every measured substantial loss is named individually; bars use a zero-preserving logarithmic visual scale. Final regressions: NOT MEASURED.
